label: SIMULATION

audited_predicates.main_claim: 'inserted' / 'not inserted' against the part keypoints in the simulator at the report instant (the env's 1 mm threshold); 'still to check' is counted, never scored; 'safety fault detected' is a consistency check, not scored
audited_predicates.part_held: against geometric contacts of both fingers with the part (distance <= 0.5 mm) at the report instant; this does not prove a stable grasp or a sufficient holding force

diagnostics_not_independently_audited: joint speeds within limits (the robot's own joint-velocity monitor)
summed finger-joint opening and the estimated pad gap: joint readings, not a measured object width
tool position: tool centre point from the kinematic model, not the part
estimated axial push and descent: from commanded joint torques, not a force sensor

consistency_note: consistency check, not scored: the env's safety flag is vel_violation | nonfinite (env.py lines 217, 220, 225), the same joint-velocity monitor the robot reads; a fault on a joint jump alone is outside that flag's definition (a mismatch of definitions, not a false claim)
reporter: retrospective: computed after the full rollout from recorded robot-side signals; it picks its own report instant and never stops or changes the controller

REF.label: SIMULATION
REF.diagnostics_not_audited: reported in each robot report, never counted as verified (AUDIT_SCOPE)
